visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man wearing a blue shirt and a multi-colored vest walks down a narrow urban street lined with scooters. He turns his head back, holding a white straw in his mouth, looking at the camera. He pulls out a red envelope with gold-colored graphics of a cartoon character and the text '金運上升'. He opens the envelope with both hands to reveal a card inside. (2) The scene cuts to a close-up of the red envelope as the man pulls out a paper that shows a split-screen illustration: the left side is Edward Elric from Fullmetal Alchemist, and the right side is a round, white cartoon character. (3) A graphic animation sequence begins, showing a glowing blue transmutation circle on a dark stone floor with white lightning-like sparks. (4) A screen recording of a digital drawing application shows a cursor drawing a hybrid character that merges the anime boy's blonde hair with the cartoon character's facial features. The process involves black line art followed by the application of yellow, blue, and skin-tone colors. (5) The final phase displays vertical scrolling comic panels from 'Fullmetal Alchemist' and a series titled 'Wei Teng Short Monthly', featuring stylized action scenes and dialogue bubbles against dynamic backgrounds.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A male creator with brown hair, wearing a blue long-sleeved shirt under a khaki and navy outdoor vest, carrying a large brown backpack.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: An urban alleyway with residential buildings and parked scooters, followed by a digital drawing software interface with various toolbars and a canvas, and finally stylized comic book panel backgrounds.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male voice speaks with a high-pitched, enthusiastic greeting towards the camera. The background sound includes the faint hum of an outdoor city environment with distant traffic. No music is playing. (2) A sharp, synthesized whoosh sound effect transitions the audio state. (3) High-energy Japanese rock music begins abruptly, featuring distorted electric guitar riffs and a prominent, fast-paced drum beat at roughly 150 BPM. A male singer's vocals are heard in the background track, exhibiting high emotional arousal. (4) The primary male speaker returns with a professional, clear narrative delivery, describing the content over the ongoing rock BGM. (5) A crackling, electrical discharge sound effect and a metallic resonance are layered as comic panel transitions occur, synchronized with the rhythmic pulse of the music.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Creative Demonstration -> Strategic Call-to-Action
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the release of the 'Fullmetal Alchemist' color webtoon version on LINE WEBTOON and the return of the creator's own comic series after a five-year hiatus. The video uses a creative challenge hook followed by a digital art demonstration to engage viewers.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct mention of the platform and specific content available for viewing.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively bridges live-action creator personality with high-quality digital art and established anime IP to maximize marketing appeal.
